meta.title: Vietnam E-Visa 2026: Complete Step-by-Step Guide (Avoid Costly Mistakes)

comments.text: Thanks for the video, just a word of warning, check your passport stamp after immigration, my gf travels on a Asian passport and we have always gotten 30 days, for some reason last time only 21, but our mistake, we  stupidly assumed 30, we overstayed by 3 days and had to spend a hell day at Viet immigration in HCMC after missing our flight to BKK, our fine was very reasonable, $70 US, but other American and Europeans who had mistakenly overstayed by double digit days ( they all had E Visas, but did not get 90 days but they never checked their entry stamps, just like us), were told they were not allowed to leave HCMC district for 21 days as their case was being processed, "Don't buy a ticket to leave in 21 days, we will tell you in 21 days when you can leave Vietnam"  a Norwegian woman was given a 4 year ban on retuning to Vietnam, a French woman was on a business visa and was facing a 1000 Euro per day fine for staying over, in other words, leave before you cross your  exit date. We got off easy but that was a day of tears, fears and frustration I witnessed at HCMC immigration office. BTW, this was in May 2026
